body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 76d8575a0ba36ee2503c00c450526d7981ecc673 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good:

- Per-client coverage for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex and Cursor: per-client tables plus headless and attached examples for each (issue #3029, item 1).
- Per-OS path table: macOS bundle, Windows installer per-user and portable, Linux DEB/RPM and tarball, with the assets-beside-the-executable and symlink rules (issue #3029, item 2). Each path claim was checked against the installer script, the package scripts and the asset resolver.
- `ai.md` links to `mcp.md` instead of repeating client instructions, and both pages end with the read-only first check (issue #3029, done definition).
- The one finding from the earlier review (ai.md required `Codex CLI`) is fixed: `site/tests/test_ai_guide.py` passes 4 of 4 at this head.
- The decision record `docs/decisions/3029-mcp-client-setup.md` records the decision, why it was made, what was dropped and the verification boundary.
- Every claim I could check against the source holds: symlink support since v0.25.0 (CHANGELOG + `crates/post/src/data_dir.rs`), loopback-only single-client listener, five-minute idle timeout, port `0` logs the selected port, per-user installer default with all-users override, Linux `/usr/lib/camcraft` layout with `/usr/bin` wrappers, and the macOS `Contents/Resources/assets` bundle layout.
- Docs only: no G-code, no geometry, no snapshot PNGs, no golden changes, no process files. ASD-STE100 wording and no HSMWorks or Autodesk material in the changed files.

Results merged with main:

- Trial merge: clean. `git merge --no-ff --no-commit origin/main` in a fresh worktree succeeds; no conflict; nothing committed by the review.
- Build, gate and clippy: none ran. This is a documentation-only change, and no cargo build, gate or heavy lane was started (see notes).
- AI guide tests: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_ai_guide.py -v` - 4 pass at this head and in a clean worktree.
- Full site suite (same run, clean worktree): 96 tests, 2 failures and 13 errors. All are pre-existing and reproduction on bare main: `test_guide_icons` (missing `tool-form-mill` and `op-rotary-flow` static icons), `test_operation_reference` (operation sections and pictures), and errors from Zola and `node` being absent on this host (`test_guide_navigation`, `test_windows_troubleshooting`, `test_search_query`, `test_generated_picture_urls`, `test_first_4axis_part`, `test_first_continuous_4axis_part`). No test the PR touches fails.
- Whitespace: `git diff origin/main...HEAD --check` passes.
- Internal links and anchors in both guides check out (`#setting-up-an-mcp-client`, `#connection-diagnostics`, `#first-check`).

Targeted tests: not applicable. No post, toolpath or example case changed; no light or heavy lane is owed for a docs-only change.

Requested before merge: none.

Questions / notes:

- This is a documentation-only PR, so no build, quick gate, light lane or heavy lane ran. The author states the quick gate selects zero steps for this diff and that no rendered site build ran because Zola is unavailable here. I verified the docs against source rather than by rendering.
- No end-to-end client sessions, cross-platform execution or attached GUI ran, and the author says so. The client instructions are source-verified, not client acceptance results.
- Pre-existing failures listed above are not fixed by this PR and are out of its scope.

Label: the earlier review's finding is fixed, the trial merge is clean, `mergeable` is `MERGEABLE` with `mergeStateStatus` `CLEAN`, so I am removing `needs-rework` and setting `merge-ready`. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
